metadata.title: How Reproducible Is a Guard Evaluation? A Measured Floor, and Where It Isn't Small
metadata.description: How reproducible is a guard evaluation? Same guard, same corpus, same seed, eighteen times. The floor is 0.09% mean pairwise disagreement, which refutes the hypothesis that motivated the experiment: effects routinely published as findings sit 4-12x above it and survive. Also refutes the standard folk explanation for guard nondeterminism. Pre-registered; two of three hypotheses refuted, including the one that motivated the paper.

metadata.title: One Ladder, Opposite Directions
metadata.description: Directional churn in quantized guard classifiers. A net rate delta is the residue after opposing per-item changes cancel. Applies a paired equivalence standard to a dedicated guard classifier, whose verdict is the measurement rather than something a judge infers, and whose two error directions are not interchangeable.

metadata.title: Masking a Field's Loss Does Not Isolate That Field
metadata.description: Masking a field's loss does not isolate that field. Five LoRA runs on a 0.6B guard model. Runs 1-2 show a masked output field moving anyway. Runs 3-5 add a three-arm target-module ablation: attention-only and MLP-only are disjoint and each independently destroys the model's third severity class, so retargeting the adapter is not available as a repair. A documented operator control becomes a silent no-op.

metadata.title: SoK: Acceptance Is Not Action
metadata.description: A systematization of agent containment: where authority and containment actually bind. Three orthogonal partitioning axes rather than topical categories, a weakest-link tier rule applied to a screened corpus, and a frozen action-surface enumeration. 48 of 49 screened works are unreviewed preprints, which conditions every claim of provable or kernel-level enforcement in the literature.

metadata.title: Positional Guard Evasion at Short Context: A Replication Note
metadata.description: Positional guard evasion at short context: a replication note. The positional effect reproduces on two models a concurrent and larger study did not test. Draft 1's claim to have refuted length dilution is retracted, and the retraction is then tested rather than conceded, over the full 0-32k range at both scales.

metadata.title: Shared Lineage, Not Shared Category, Makes Guards Fail Together
metadata.description: Shared lineage, not shared category, makes guards fail together. A replication and extension of concurrent work on layered defenses, running the difficulty stratification its authors nominated as the most valuable extension: 899 unsafe items across 150 payload clusters against six guards sharing no substrate, roughly nine times the original behaviour count.
